• Mudrarakshasa is a political drama written by Vishakdatta, dealing with the rise of Chandragupta Maurya.

• Nagananda is a play written by Harsha.

• Ratnavali is another play authored by Emperor Harsha, revolving around romance and political intrigue.

• Arthasastra written by Kautilya, or Chanakya, and focuses on governance and economic policies.

• Mudrarakshasa written by Vishakdatta is a play set focuses on the political strategies behind Chandragupta's rise.

• Brihat Samhita by Varahamihira is a classical work on astronomy and astrology.

• Panchasiddhantika by Varahamihira is a treatise on Indian astronomy.

• Charaka Samhita is a classical text on ancient Indian medicine (Ayurveda), attributed to Charaka.

• Babur authored "Baburnama," which is considered the first true autobiography in Islamic literature.
